summary: Iter 141 — e2e regression for the 3 New Look V2 shipments (Player Bar, Live Hero Vibe, Sell-the-Rail). BACKEND 6/6 passing (pytest iter141): /api/shell/home returns 'top_genre' key (None for admin/anonymous — expected fallback); advertiser rail buy→mock checkout→list flow works (POST create → 200 with campaign_id; POST /checkout → ok:true mock:true; GET list shows the campaign with status 'pending' and slot_keys=['right_rail_mpu_1']); missing/blank creative does NOT 500 (returns <500); GET /api/ads/banner/decision?slot_key=right_rail_mpu_{1,2,3} returns source='house' size 300x250 for freeuser@bigfm.dubai; same endpoint returns source='none' for premium@bigfm.dubai. FRONTEND (web, both desktop 1920 & mobile 390): (a) HERO — data-testid='nlv2-hero' has data-vibe='morning' matching container-server local hour (5-11), image = the morning Unsplash URL, headline = 'Rise & shine'; genre tag correctly absent (freeuser has no favorite_genres → top_genre=null); no crash on null. (b) PLAYER BAR — nlv2-player-bar renders at x=240 y=986 w=1440 on desktop (wide, above content); on mobile 390x844 it sits at y=702 with height=70 and the bottom nav (nlv2-bottom-nav) sits at y=778 — 6px gap, NO overlap; play button present; manual 'bigfm:player:toggle' event fires the internal listener (verified in-page). (c) SELL THE RAIL — logged in as test@bigfm.dubai advertiser, /advertiser/dashboard/banner-campaigns shows advertiser-rail-panel with 3 slot cards (advertiser-rail-slot-right_rail_mpu_{1,2,3}); advertiser-rail-buy-toggle opens advertiser-rail-form; filling creative + click URL + budget + submit posts to backend and the rail-list shows PENDING rows (3 existing pending campaigns confirmed via UI + backend).

ui_bugs.issue: Review spec expects data-testid='nlv2-hero-genre' but code emits data-testid='nlv2-hero-genre-tag' (HeroNewLookV2.jsx:70). Genre tag is null for admin/freeuser (no favorite_genres) so not testable at runtime with seeded accounts — the testID naming is the only issue. Either rename to 'nlv2-hero-genre' OR update the review spec to 'nlv2-hero-genre-tag'.

action_items: Optional: align HeroNewLookV2 genre-tag testID with the review spec — rename 'nlv2-hero-genre-tag' → 'nlv2-hero-genre' (HeroNewLookV2.jsx:70) OR update review spec to match. Everything else works.

Optional: to fully exercise the genre-aware sub-copy path at runtime, seed a user with preference_vector.favorite_genres = ['bollywood'] (or similar) — verified via API contract that top_genre populates but no such account currently exists.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerBarV2.jsx toggle handler is correctly split: main play button (nlv2-player-play) calls onToggle() which either dispatches 'bigfm:player:toggle' when hasContent OR falls back to fetching /api/stations/flagship and redirecting to /radio/station/{id}?autoplay=1 (or /radio/browse). Good — no double dispatch. Artwork click only toggles when hasContent (button is disabled otherwise) — good.

shell.py /home top_genre logic (lines 454-462) takes the FIRST entry from preference_vector.favorite_genres, .title()-cases it, and returns None on any exception — nice defensive fallback. Anonymous request path also returns top_genre=None (user=None → gl=[]).

AdvertiserBannerCampaigns.RightRailSlotsPanel client-side validation checks click_url + creative_image_url against /^https?:\/\/.+/ before POST — good; empty inputs never crash the backend (verified 4xx not 5xx). Success path attempts window.location.href to checkout_url only when it looks like an http(s) URL — safe.

Minor: RAIL_KEYS filter in load() uses .some() so a mixed-slot campaign (e.g. right_rail_mpu_1 + landing_hero) would appear in this rail list even though it also covers a non-rail zone. Acceptable since these forms only offer rail slots.
